mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_order ( payment_no, order_id, user_id, amount, channel, status, paid_at, callback_at, closed_at, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{paymentNo}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{paidAt}, #{callbackAt}, #{closedAt}, #{failReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_no, order_id, user_id, amount, channel, status, paid_at, callback_at, closed_at, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_order WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo}

SELECT id, payment_no, order_id, user_id, amount, channel, status, paid_at, callback_at, closed_at, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_order WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, payment_no, order_id, user_id, amount, channel, status, paid_at, callback_at, closed_at, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, payment_no, order_id, user_id, amount, channel, status, paid_at, callback_at, closed_at, fail_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_order SET status = 'SUCCESS', paid_at = #{paidAt}, callback_at = #{callbackAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND status IN ('INIT', 'PAYING')
UPDATE payment_order SET status = 'FAILED', callback_at = #{callbackAt}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND status IN ('INIT', 'PAYING')
UPDATE payment_order SET status = 'CLOSED', closed_at = #{closedAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('INIT', 'PAYING')
